turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I still haven't ordered the cake for Saturday.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: There's still time if you order today. Chocolate is always popular, or would a fruity one like lemon fit better?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Excuse me for a moment, my friend has a question. Don't talk until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did the plumber call you back?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: He did. He can come Thursday morning.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thursday? The sink's been leaking since Sunday.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I know. He said everyone's pipes are freezing this week.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did he say how much it would be?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Not really. Just that it depends what he finds.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Great, very reassuring. Can you put a bucket under it in the meantime?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're finished. Please carry on, Moshi.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. Did you decide on the cake flavor?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, and another thing. I've never driven a big van before and I'm moving with one next week.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Practise a bit before the big day if you can, maybe a short drive around quiet streets.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The height and width. Know the van's height and watch for low bridges and car park barriers.
